rows.content_decision: PDF 31 heading/judgment date17 January 2014 and PDF 33 paragraph 4 support the printed Tonga Democratic Party leader recital; alias and effective term unresolved.
PDF 3 paragraph 4 supports the unincorporated-body/capacity recital; no officer, registration determination or party alias is established.
PDF 21 paragraph 34 reports what Tongasat sought to show; it does not establish the truth of the no-funds proposition.
Article created 14 December 2013 attributes the cited passage and its source to PGA Forum; body gives September 2010 establishment. No office or exact day.
Employment History body gives establishment in 2010; no founding day or leader-office evidence.

The printed entry dateline is 17 March 2020 (not the URL's March18). The paragraph beginning Ko e me'a pango expressly attributes to PMO the claims that PTOA had not registered up to that day as the law requires and had no legal body or constitution. The quoted Tongan matches the extract; the narrow English rendering is supported. This is a government rebuttal assertion, not an independent registry/legal-status finding. No PTOA officer, alias or term is established. The later paragraph about another party is outside intake.
